title: PTXBench: Benchmark and Adapt LLMs for GPU Kernel Optimization with Architecture-specific PTX
abstract: arXiv:2608.17379v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce PTXBench, a benchmark for evaluating and adapting large language models (LLMs) to use architecture-specific PTX for GPU kernel optimization. PTXBench measures functional correctness, whether selected target instructions execute at runtime, and speedup over frontier libraries across GEMM and attention workloads on H100 and B200 GPUs. Our evaluation shows that architecture-specific PTX capability remains uneven: success rates fall substantially on complex attention backward workloads, and executing the target instructions does not necessarily translate into competitive performance. No evaluated model consistently matches frontier libraries across the suite. We further adapt Qwen3.6-27B using supervised fine-tuning. Repair-conditioned training improves several tasks, but generalization remains uneven; data coverage, balance, and the quality of the reasoning teacher matter in addition to dataset size. translated_title: PTXBench：面向GPU内核优化的架构特定PTX基准测试与LLM适配
translated_abstract: 我们介绍了PTXBench，一个用于评估和适配大语言模型（LLMs）以使用架构特定PTX进行GPU内核优化的基准测试。PTXBench衡量功能正确性、所选目标指令是否在运行时执行，以及在H100和B200 GPU上针对GEMM和注意力工作负载相对于前沿库的加速效果。我们的评估表明，架构特定PTX能力仍不均衡：在复杂的注意力反向工作负载上，成功率大幅下降，且执行目标指令并不一定能转化为有竞争力的性能。没有评估的模型在整套测试中持续匹配前沿库。我们进一步使用监督微调适配了Qwen3.6-27B。修复条件训练改善了几项任务，但泛化能力仍不均衡；数据覆盖、平衡和推理教师的质量除了数据集大小外也很重要。PTXBench提供了音频...
tldr: 本文提出PTXBench基准测试，用于评估和适配LLM在GPU内核优化中使用架构特定PTX的能力，并发现现有模型性能不均，通过监督微调可部分改善但泛化有限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PTXBench, a benchmark for evaluating and adapting LLMs to use architecture-specific PTX for GPU kernel optimization, revealing uneven model capabilities and showing that supervised fine-tuning yields partial improvements with limited generalization.
